teacherNotes.title: 5-Step Vocab Progression
teacherNotes.content: 1. Recognition -> 2. Pronunciation -> 3. Classification -> 4. Controlled Production -> 5. Personalised Use

teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: alphabet, letter, spell, vowel, consonant, word, double, capital letter, small letter, sign, email, dot, at

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
alphabet, letter, spell, vowel, consonant, word, double, capital letter, small letter, sign, email, dot, at
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• How do you spell...? (asking for spelling)
• Could you spell that, please? (polite spelling request)
• That's D-A-V-I-D (spelling aloud)
• Double 'O' (indicating repeated letter)
• Capital 'A' (indicating uppercase)

teacherNotes.title: Phonetic Aim
teacherNotes.content: English Alphabet letter names: Letter groupings by vowel sound (/eɪ/: A, H, J, K; /iː/: B, C, D, E, G, P, T, V, Z).

elements.content: Pronunciation Focus:
English Alphabet letter names: Letter groupings by vowel sound (/eɪ/: A, H, J, K; /iː/: B, C, D, E, G, P, T, V, Z).

teacherNotes.title: Function-First Grammar Rule
teacherNotes.content: Question form 'How do you spell [word]?' using present simple auxiliary 'do'. Pronouncing individual letter names clearly.

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Question form 'How do you spell [word]?' using present simple auxiliary 'do'. Pronouncing individual letter names clearly.
Examples:

• How do you spell your surname?
• It's S-M-I-T-H.
• How do you spell 'teacher'?
• T-E-A-C-H-E-R.
options: How do you spell your surname?
answers: How do you spell your surname?

elements.content: Reading Dialogue & Script:

Script using target language:
Person A: How do you spell...?
Person B: Could you spell that, please?
Listening Comprehension Prompt: Listen to the prompt and confirm understanding.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: Pair roleplay, information gap, and personalized speaking task.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice with your partner: I can spell my name and understand spelled words and codes.
Short Writing Task (~10%): Write 3-4 sentences in your notebook applying target chunks.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy
teacherNotes.content: Choose 60m, 90m, or 120m flow based on scheduled class length.

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60 min Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up Alphabet Song; 10-25m Letter Pronunciation & Chunks; 25-40m 'How do you spell...?' Grammar & Dictation; 40-55m Name-spelling Pair Task; 55-60m Cool-down.

• 90 min Flow (Expanded): 0-15m Alphabet Drill; 15-30m Vowel/Consonant Classification; 30-50m Spelling Dictations (names, emails); 50-70m Interactive Spelling Bee; 70-85m Form filling; 85-90m Wrap-up.

• 120 min Flow (Full Workshop): 0-20m Alphabet Phonetics Lab; 20-45m Spelling Chunks & Rules; 45-75m Extensive Audio Dictation & Pair Exchange; 75-105m Business Contact Form Project; 105-120m Reflection.
